meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 群中搭建常驻 wiki 知识库:创建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录及索引、日志文件,并在群配置中写入维护规则。之后收到资料时,Claude 会逐条读取并整理成 wiki 页面,而不是批量处理。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等触发词,或要求在 NanoClaw 群里建立知识库时。

say.text: 给这个 NanoClaw 群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 会开始执行添加 wiki 的搭建流程。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 收进 wiki,一条条处理
say.note: 会逐文件读取并更新对应 wiki 页面。

say.text: 安排每周做一次 wiki 健康检查
say.note: 会设置定期 lint 检查任务。

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ dirs, index/log files, and maintenance rules in group config. Later, sources are processed one at a time into wiki pages, not in batch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", etc., or ask to set up a knowledge base in the NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this NanoClaw group.
Put this PDF into the wiki, one file at a time.
say_en.note: Reads it and updates wiki pages.

say_en.text: Schedule a weekly wiki health check.
say_en.note: Sets up a recurring lint task.
